title: Hawkins, HTM and the Numenta-related research family — complete preserved catalog
scope: All 1,089 historical record IDs remain visible. Family membership does not mean Jeff Hawkins authored every document.
metadata_status: Historical donor grades, chronology classes and bibliographic metadata; not a fresh source or scientific certificate.
author_boundary: Five target versions and 112 records have no listed author edges. Their authorship remains unknown. Custodians and institutions are displayed separately and do not create author edges.
date_boundary: Dates are drawn from target metadata fields, never donor filenames. Current-2026 and BSB-2025 donor names describe later Micah formulations, not later target publications. Link dates, exact-body custody, metadata and publication dates remain distinct in source review.
evidence_status_disclaimer: Selected source comparisons are visible as a local publication candidate; release review remains separate. All other historical evidence bodies remain unreleased and visible as such. Unknown authors are not inferred.
count_units: Historical comparison records, target document/version keys and author association edges are separate quantities; author edges are not additional findings.
